caption: Controlled mutation separates a proposed edit from its effects. Supported operations resolve targets against current state and pass selected guards before mutation. Per-operation results include refusals; successful session operations and remediation-pass mutations use distinct attribution channels. A comparison affects admission only when its consumer refuses the prohibited edit; any direct write path lies outside this boundary.

svg_title: Controlled mutation separates proposals from effects
svg_description: A flexible producer emits a typed proposal. The resolver uses the document structure model of current artifact state. A before-value comparison reports mismatches by default; it is not the hard admission gate. Within the controlled application boundary, the supported operation vocabulary and selected guards determine whether the applier may mutate the resolved target. Per-operation results include refusal and failure. Successful session edits and remediation-pass mutations produce distinct attribution records. Unmigrated direct edits remain outside this route.
